subject: Life Skills
title: ATM Safety Abroad
description: A short lesson to help you apply ATM Safety Abroad.

hook.text: He used a standalone ATM on a quiet side street in Bangkok. His card was skimmed and drained within 24 hours.

buildup.text: ATM skimmers are nearly invisible devices placed over the card slot. They copy your card data while you withdraw cash.

discovery.text: Use ATMs inside banks during business hours. They are monitored, maintained.

twist.text: A common trick: someone 'helps' you with a jammed machine. While helping, they watch your PIN or swap your card.

climax.text: Cover the keypad with your other hand every time. Cameras above capture PINs easily. One hand shields everything.

punchline.text: Bank ATMs, business hours, hand over keypad. Always.

quiz.question: Where is the safest place to use an ATM abroad?
options: Any ATM with a well-known bank logo
Inside a bank branch during business hours
